_why: Panels this pipeline cannot derive. The analyzer has no window and reports over whole histories up to the pin, so every stretch-scoped count is read by hand; each is declared with the command that produces it, counted at the commit corpus.json pins for that source, and drawn as declared rather than derived wherever it appears.
